notes.title: New Update: NPCs Are Here! The City Comes to Life 🌭🏙️
notes.notes:
Big news, chefs!
We're bringing Street Chef - Food Seller Simulator one step closer to a living, breathing (and hungry) city with our latest update. Here's what's new on the streets:


🧍‍♂️ NPC Behaviors Added
The city now feels alive! NPCs will now sunbathe, chat, run, and go about their daily lives—bringing more energy and immersion to your hotdog-selling hustle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349762/389d3ad729e92cd53fb696e361fe438980e6b491.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349762/c2bfabdb79a3c8546f55dd03aeea48edd10b8b33.png

🌭 NPC Order System Implemented
NPCs can now walk order hotdogs from your cart! Get ready to serve a variety of customers with different cravings and personalities. Don’t keep them waiting!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349762/d7878d29825a2404e2a385c66533c496b51cbbfe.png

🎭 Different NPC Models for Diversity

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349762/d6a4f6635acbbbe0ac9b8ec04d2b790cbb240acc.png


Get out there, fire up the grill, and serve the city!

Let us know what you think about these changes—we're always cooking up more features based on your feedback. 🔥
